Refreshed digest-bound packet for independent DELTA review at work/records/2026/10/finding-v12-development-coordination-pilot/evidence/native-handoffs-1-correction-2/ (CORRECTION.md, manifest.json sha256 4925897d2bdf6e343d6eac229544b7c2c308f31fbf59ce01ec8b70b9c2aafd24). Candidate: 36 paths over 3d05430f (retained parent a743edeb; previously reviewed 766f97f2 reconstructed from its packet and verified 35/35), tree digest sha256:f62bbaab53c7d6a7f9730b726d68fac8cefe48a92130cdc176924acd1ec64028; patches candidate-from-3d05430f 265f6d3e…, delta-from-a743edeb 8f0395da…, delta-from-766f97f2 9a50ac60… (the review delta: 4 paths — tools/bootstrap.py, tests/tools/test_bootstrap.py, tests/tools/test_connected_creation.py new to the set, v12/STACK.md); all three reproductions verified byte for byte (provenance.json). Host tree, instance, stores and Git untouched (v12 clean, HEAD 3d05430f); K holds no claim; no import, rebuild or live launch.

R4a: bootstrap._routing_faults now asks authority.messages.check_routing about the exact policy document _compose would persist — the validator Authority.native_routing() applies at every handoff-capable preparation — so both addresses are held to the Authority's participant grammar and the one-address rule is stated once there (the duplicate bootstrap spelling removed); role-membership and implementer/reviewer separation checks retained. And bootstrap.main now proves the routing selection (_routing_preflight, exactly the check held makes) BEFORE admitting a runtime, cloning repositories or making prerequisite roots, in both the destination and the repeat forms — those admissions precede prepare's whole-document validation by design, so a malformed address could otherwise leave durable effects even with a grammar check. (A first cut proved the whole document early; it changed four existing installer cases' pinned refusals for skeletal documents and was withdrawn for the selection-only preflight.) Proofs: test_bootstrap TheNativeHandoffRoutingIsConfiguredHere (14): nine malformed spellings for each address refused with "a participant is team.member" and nothing composed; the shared validator refuses exactly those; a refused repeat leaves the valid policy and grant unchanged. test_connected_creation TheNativeRoutingThroughTheRealInstaller (4) through the REAL bootstrap.main and job_manager.main: fresh two-role install with the selection → ordinary /3 creation under native-handoff/1 → scoped answer-handoff held, review not held, Job handoff-capable, selection kept in install-inputs.json and absent from the execution document (the reviewer's positive probe retained); the reviewer's failing probe (decision_recipient "not-an-address") now exits 2 with the refusal and nothing durable at the destination (no selector, record, configuration, Authority store, install document); malformed reviewer likewise; a refused one-operand repeat leaves install-inputs.json bytes and the policy unchanged. No existing test expectation changed. STACK.md routing paragraph updated.

Verification (prepared 3.13.7; roots /var/tmp/baton-v12-handoffs-1/recovery; final runs on the outside-checkout copy; logs in the packet): six-module argv Ran 342 OK; bootstrap/connected-creation/environment/instance/stack 538 OK; just test-group authority 509/509; scans 492 passed + 2 optional skips of 494; job_manager 1715/1718 (same three identities as before); tools-pure 3517/3520 (test_live_ab, test_source_identity ×2 as before; round 1's transient PR-seed case passed, which attributes nothing); manager-pure run as 59 modules MINUS test_checkpoint_profiles via python -m unittest (not the accounted runner): 4391 ran, 6 failures = the same six identities. A withdrawn first cut that proved the WHOLE document early broke four installer cases (test_environment ×1, test_instance ×3, pinned refusals for skeletal documents); its chain logs are kept under logs/withdrawn-whole-document-preflight/ as evidence, not as this candidate's result. Not claimed: acceptance, live execution, image rebuild, the three checkpoint_profiles classes (hazard, not rerun), attribution of round 1's transient PR-seed failure (cause unknown; a pass here does not attribute it), next slice; status-timeout finding unchanged. PROGRESS.md appended. Ready for independent delta review through baton.codx; holding.
